description: Calculate centering-only maximum grades from ratios already known. Costs 1 credit. Supply at least one face/axis ratio; never guess missing faces or axes. Read incomplete, missing_faces and missing_axes; missing measurements can lower the ceiling. Numeric 1 is ambiguous; use 55, 0.55, 55/45 or [55,45]. Do not mix nested and corresponding flat fields. Growth and higher; Developer excluded. Verified Free trial: 5 measure and 5 confirm calls independently; grade and standards have no separate trial call counter. Always display: ceiling from centering alone, not a prediction of the final grade. Never call results verified or certified. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.
